tools.name: search
tools.description:
Find public documentary films by concise title, director, topic or keyword.

    For duration, subtitle, year and audio filters use search_documentaries.
    Availability describes GuideDoc's catalogue; territorial restrictions may apply.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description:
Read a public film URL returned by search. Never returns playback or private data.

    The canonical GuideDoc URL is revalidated against the same current public
    database gate as WebMCP. Use get_documentary for full public editorial details.

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Find published filmmaker/contributor profiles linked to public documentaries.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: Read a published person's biography and only their public documentary records.

tools.name: browse_topics
tools.description: Find public genre/topic collections and canonical page links.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Find published documentary articles. Scheduled posts and private previews are excluded.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read public article text using a numeric ID returned by search_articles.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description:
Read public FAQs and find current country-specific plans/help/legal links.

    Consult the plans page for current prices. Never reads accounts, subscriptions,
    invoices or support tickets, and never purchases or changes a subscription.

tools.name: open_catalogue
tools.description:
Search and display documentary titles, filmmakers or topics inside GuideDoc.

    When this explorer is active, use for bare or ambiguous titles before answering
    from another meaning: 'Mon Petit' means query='Mon Petit', not a translation.
    Honor explicit translation/unrelated requests. Nonem

tools.name: catalogue_search
tools.description: Search from the explorer without remounting its interface.

tools.name: catalogue_film
tools.description: Revalidate publication before displaying public editorial film details.

tools.name: catalogue_related
tools.description: Recommendations based on public subjects and credits, with reasons.

tools.name: search_documentaries
tools.description: Search and display documentary films in the GuideDoc explorer. Use concise title, director or topic terms and explicit filters. Keep the latest query and filters for follow-ups, changing only what the user requests. Unrestricted searches cover all records. English metadata; audio/subtitle filters re

tools.name: get_documentary
tools.description: Read and display a verified public documentary film in the GuideDoc explorer. Use the numeric ID from current results or selected-film context. Preserve original titles. Pass current filters so subsequent recommendations retain them. Full films open on GuideDoc, with normal access requirements. Pass

tools.name: recommend_documentaries
tools.description: Find and display similar documentaries with reasons in the GuideDoc explorer. For "more like the second one", use the ID at visible position 2 in explorer context. Preserve explicit duration, subtitle and subject filters. Defaults to films available on GuideDoc unless another scope is requested. No

tools.name: catalogue_sync
tools.description:
Read a new selection intent for this temporary anonymous explorer instance.

    Revalidate each new selection through the current public gate.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "open_catalogue" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search and display documentary titles, filmmakers or topics inside GuideDoc. When this explorer is active, use for bare or ambiguous titles before answering fro…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "open_catalogue" is 655 chars, far longer than this server's median (118). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet:
before: "Use this when someone seeks documentary films by title, director, topic or keyword. Search GuideDoc's public film database, including reference films that cannot currently be streamed. Do not use for fiction, private GuideDoc records or streaming availability outside GuideDoc.

    Args:
        que" → after: "Find public documentary films by concise title, director, topic or keyword.

    For duration, subtitle, year and audio filters use search_documentaries.
    Availability describes GuideDoc's catalogue; territorial restrictions may apply."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

evidence.snippet:
before: "Use this after search to read the public film page and cite its canonical GuideDoc URL. It gives a documentary's verified page details and GuideDoc streaming status; it does not provide private records or availability on other services.

    Args:
        id: Exact GuideDoc film URL returned as `id`" → after: "Read a public film URL returned by search. Never returns playback or private data.

    The canonical GuideDoc URL is revalidated against the same current public
    database gate as WebMCP. Use get_documentary for full public editorial details."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
